content.content: When refusing an invocation, the deccy CLI shall write exactly one newline-terminated line to stderr containing the refusal and no additional text.
content.rationale: Seven refusal decisions fix when to refuse and four naming atoms fix what the refusal contains, but nothing fixes where or in what shape it reaches the caller; agents read streams before text, so channel discipline is requirement. Mirroring the version-line form keeps the refusal a single greppable line and leaves stdout a pure result stream.
